mechanism_narrative: A high federal funds rate level compresses equity valuations through increased discount rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals monetary tightening, reducing equity market returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous weakness in GDP growth (GDPC1) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals an imminent economic contraction, triggering negative equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when GDPC1 < 0.5% and INDPRO < 0.3%.

mechanism_narrative: In high unemployment regimes (UNRATE > 4.5%), the Federal Reserve implements monetary easing to stimulate employment, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when HOUST < 1300 and RSAFS < 700,000.

mechanism_narrative: A high consumer price inflation level (CPIAUCSL) signals persistent monetary tightening, reducing equity market returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL exceeds 310.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below the 2017 base level (INDPRO < 100) signals manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100.

mechanism_narrative: In a weak housing market (HOUST < 1300), the Federal Reserve maintains or cuts interest rates to support demand, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when HOUST falls below 1300.
